title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the reflection coefficient R must be provided.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the dielectric constant epsilon in the calculation.

title: Reflection Coefficient Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive or reference the correct formula for the reflection coefficient for normal incidence.

title: Mathematical Accuracy
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show accurate algebraic manipulation leading to the final answer.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the reflection coefficient formula.
